# 1 Clement Chapter 19 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 19 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_019_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 19

**19:1** The humility and submissive obedience of so many great men — attested as they are — has not only benefited us but also the generations before us, those who received his oracles in fear and truth.

**19:2** Since, therefore, we have a share in so many great and glorious acts, let us press forward to reach the goal of peace that has been handed down to us from the beginning, and let us look up to the Father and Creator of the whole universe, and let us hold fast to his splendid and surpassing gifts of peace and beneficence.

**19:3** Let us behold him in our mind; let us look with the eyes of the soul upon his patient will; let us think how free from wrath he is toward his whole creation.

---

*LOGOS formal equivalence.*
